hints.title: Local Alternating Parity Invariant
hints.text: At even indices i, nums[i] should be at most nums[i+1]. At odd indices i, nums[i] should be at least nums[i+1].

hints.title: Single-Pass Greedy Local Swapping
hints.text: Whenever the local ordering relation between nums[i] and nums[i+1] is violated, swapping them fixes the violation without disrupting previously satisfied elements.

hints.title: Sequential Element Swap Procedure
hints.text: Loop from index zero to n minus two. If the index is even and nums[i] is strictly greater than nums[i+1], swap them. If the index is odd and nums[i] is strictly less than nums[i+1], swap them.

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full sorting followed by interleaving takes O(N log N) time and extra array space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear pass with local greedy swaps achieves valid wiggle ordering in O(N) time and strictly O(1) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should prove why swapping nums[i] and nums[i+1] does not break the already established relationship with nums[i-1].
